what_it_is: bringup.c/bringup.h: original pure-C Darwin engine for m1n1's T8103 sequence in 23 steps. Steps 1-12 are shared: PMGR power for IMX, APCIE, APCIE_GP and PCIE_REF; axi2af, common and PHY tunables; PHY clock requests and reset release; PHYIF RUN; fuses; PHY-IP PLL and auspma tunables. Steps 13-23 are port 0: config tunables, APPCLK, PERST release, waits for RUN and not-BUSY, DBI write enable, rc/gen3/gen4 tunables, link speed 2, one-lane width, DBI write disable, LINKSTS. All register access goes through caller callbacks. Write targets are whitelisted or parser-checked tunables, polls are bounded, and a run is one-shot with no retry on a dirty record. BRINGUP.md lists the differences from m1n1.
gate: The writer call for shared regions (PMGR, RC, PHY, PHY-IP, AXI) is compiled only under APB_FAKE_REGISTER_FILE, which only the host test defines. An #error refuses that macro whenever KERNEL is defined, and every kext source has KERNEL. Without the macro, the shared branch returns APB_GATED, and because the shared steps come first, a bundle run stops at step 1 with zero writes. No adapter code calls apb_bringup_port0.

checks.host: test_bringup.py exit 0. C tests run under ASan/UBSan against a simulated register file (full sequence, ordering, RMW values, fuses, 16-bit LNKCTL2, every timeout, I/O faults, dirty refusal) and in gated mode (stops at POWER, zero write calls). Gate proofs: the kernel-plus-fake compile is refused, and the kernel-mode shared branch has no writer. The saved private J293 ADT (5f2ad465...): all nine real tunable sets parse into their windows and the link speed resolves to 2. Only counts are printed.
checks.sdk_bundle: build-bringup-gate.nix exit 0. It builds the slice-1 bundle plus bringup.c as kernel code (ARM64 MH_BUNDLE, executable 112927 B, sha256 f70c1b0d15349b38199422edafdb0234471823bfec1b7d7a4984fdc781e9f2e9). Frozen board.c and survey.h hash-verified. bringup.c compiled with -DKERNEL, without the fake macro, and with no warnings.
checks.binary: check_bringup_bundle.py exit 0. apb_shared_writes_compiled is mov w0,#0; ret. The shared branch of wr() increments gated_writes and returns 1 with no call. There are five indirect calls (rd, delay, the port-path write, and LNKCTL2 read16/write16). Nothing refers to apb_bringup_port0. The bundle text matches the kernel object opcode for opcode.

provenance: Original code. The sequence, offsets and bits come from m1n1 src/pcie.c, src/pmgr.c and src/tunables.c (MIT, commit 121fcbf3). The only data copied is the 11-entry T8103 fuse table, credited in NOTICE-bringup. No GPL pcie-apple.c or other Linux source, no Apple source or kext, no firmware.
not_done_by_design: no kernel collection built, modified or linked
no RAM disk, packet or boot staged
no SSH, no hardware, no Signal
slice-1 files, m1n1, recovery, GPU observer and the network-link, network-egress, default-route and default-client files untouched
next: Before any live use: an IOKit apb_io backend with writable maps, a decision on PMGR through the platform versus raw writes, any Wi-Fi power or PERST# GPIO needs, and a scope review of the shared PHY and PMGR writes (IMX is a parent domain shared with other SoC blocks). Then config space and IOPCIBridge nubs. Boots stay with root under the usual gates.
